SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS copd_patients_received_tiotropium
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_copd
  ON ca_copd.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
 AND ca_copd.ancestor_concept_id = 255573
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca_drug
    ON ca_drug.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
   AND ca_drug.ancestor_concept_id = 1106776
  WHERE de.person_id = co.person_id
)
